decision: Deployed because it tied the strongest source-level validation result and outperformed the available ViT and hybrid alternatives on the existing held-out patch evaluation.
pytorch_hybrid_status: Experimental one-epoch CPU baseline only; it is retained for architecture research and is not served by the production API.
limitations: Small source-level validation and test sets contain only five cubes each.
Patch-level measurements are correlated within a source cube.
This is a disease-classification prototype, not a validated pre-symptom forecasting system.
